# load data

```{r, label="import spores",results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Import outlines: First list jpeg files to import
# Load your files
eco <- read_csv("Results/Ecology/Ecology_maximum_inferred.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

pca <- read_csv("Results/PCA/PCA_Spore_Scores_Aggregated_with_Count.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

vol <- read_csv("Results/Volume/Volume.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

loc <- read_csv("Results/Weather/Location_Date.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

# Merge all

```

```{r}

# Merge all
df <- pca %>% left_join(vol, by = "species") 

# -------------------------------
# Summarize morphometric + climate data per species
# -------------------------------
df_clean <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(PC1_mean)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_volume_estimated)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("species")

df_pruned <- df_clean  # Just use the cleaned dataset
df_pruned$species <- rownames(df_pruned)

```

```{r}
# === Load location data and Köppen raster ===

loc <- read_csv("Results/Weather/Location_Date.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

# Remove rows with missing lat/lon
loc_clean <- loc %>%
  filter(!is.na(Lat_machine_readable), !is.na(Long_machine_readable))
loc_sf <- st_as_sf(loc_clean, coords = c("Long_machine_readable", "Lat_machine_readable"), crs = 4326)

# === Load raster before using it ===
koppen_raster <- terra::rast("Analyses/weather_and_geography/Climate_zones_phylogeny_morphology_June26/koppen_geiger_tif/1991_2020/koppen_geiger_0p00833333.tif")

# === Transform your spatial points to raster's CRS ===
loc_transformed <- st_transform(loc_sf, crs(koppen_raster))

# === Extract Köppen values ===
koppen_values <- terra::extract(koppen_raster, vect(loc_transformed))

# === Assign to data ===
loc_clean$koppen_code <- koppen_values[,2]

```

# Climate data analysis

```{r, label="climate_data", results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Transform projection to match raster
loc_transformed <- st_transform(loc_sf, crs(koppen_raster))

# Extract Köppen values
koppen_values <- terra::extract(koppen_raster, vect(loc_transformed))
loc_clean$koppen_code <- koppen_values[,2]

# === Optional: lookup Köppen labels ===
koppen_lookup <- tibble::tibble(
  koppen_code = 1:30,
  koppen_label = c(
    "Af",  "Am",  "Aw",  "BWh", "BWk", "BSh", "BSk",
    "Csa", "Csb", "Csc", "Cwa", "Cwb", "Cwc",
    "Cfa", "Cfb", "Cfc",
    "Dsa", "Dsb", "Dsc", "Dsd",
    "Dwa", "Dwb", "Dwc", "Dwd",
    "Dfa", "Dfb", "Dfc", "Dfd",
    "ET",  "EF"
  ),
  koppen_desc = c(
    "Tropical rainforest", "Tropical monsoon", "Tropical savannah",
    "Hot desert", "Cold desert", "Hot steppe", "Cold steppe",
    "Hot-summer Mediterranean", "Warm-summer Mediterranean", "Cold-summer Mediterranean",
    "Dry winter, hot summer (subtropical)", "Dry winter, warm summer (subtropical)",
    "Dry winter, cold summer (subtropical)",
    "Humid subtropical, hot summer", "Oceanic (marine west coast)", "Subpolar oceanic",
    "Continental, dry summer, hot", "Continental, dry summer, warm",
    "Continental, dry summer, cold", "Continental, dry summer, extreme",
    "Continental, dry winter, hot", "Continental, dry winter, warm",
    "Continental, dry winter, cold", "Continental, dry winter, extreme",
    "Continental, no dry season, hot", "Continental, no dry season, warm",
    "Continental, no dry season, cold", "Continental, no dry season, extreme",
    "Tundra", "Ice cap"
  )
)

# Add broad climate group
koppen_lookup$climate_group <- dplyr::case_when(
  koppen_lookup$koppen_label %in% c("Af", "Am", "Aw", "As") ~ "Tropical",
  koppen_lookup$koppen_label %in% c("BWh", "BWk", "BSh", "BSk") ~ "Arid",
  koppen_lookup$koppen_label %in% c("Csa", "Csb", "Csc", "Cwa", "Cwb", "Cwc", "Cfa", "Cfb", "Cfc") ~ "Temperate",
  koppen_lookup$koppen_label %in% c("Dsa", "Dsb", "Dsc", "Dsd", "Dwa", "Dwb", "Dwc", "Dwd", "Dfa", "Dfb", "Dfc", "Dfd") ~ "Continental",
  koppen_lookup$koppen_label %in% c("ET", "EF") ~ "Polar",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
)

loc_clean <- loc_clean %>% left_join(koppen_lookup, by = "koppen_code")

```

```{r, label="climate_summary", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}


# === Summarize: Most common climate zone per species ===
climate_summary <- loc_clean %>%
  dplyr::group_by(species, koppen_label, koppen_desc, climate_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(species) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()



```

```{r, label="merge_climate_data", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Merge with df_pruned ===

df_pruned <- df_pruned %>%
  dplyr::left_join(climate_summary, by = "species")


table(df_pruned$koppen_label, useNA = "ifany")


```

```{r, label="climate_data_summary", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

na_species <- df_pruned %>%
  filter(is.na(koppen_label)) %>%
  dplyr::select(species)

# Now join and inspect coordinates
missing_with_coords <- na_species %>%
  left_join(loc_clean, by = "species") %>%
  dplyr::select(species, Lat_machine_readable, Long_machine_readable)

print(missing_with_coords)

```

```{r, label="climate_data_summary", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Look into suspicious species and climate data

# Subset the species assigned to polar climates
polar_species <- df_pruned %>%
  filter(koppen_label %in% c("ET", "EF")) %>%
  dplyr::select(species, koppen_label, climate_group)

print(polar_species)

```

# Prune data to remove rows with NA coordinates
# Plot the cleaned data on a map of the Köppen climate zones
```{r, label="climate_data_summary", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

df_pruned_clean <- df_pruned %>%
  filter(!is.na(Lat_machine_readable), !is.na(Long_machine_readable))



```

```{r, label="climate_data_summary", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)

# Base world map
world_map <- map_data("world")

ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = world_map, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "gray95", color = "gray80") +
  geom_point(data = df_pruned_clean,
             aes(x = Long_machine_readable, y = Lat_machine_readable, color = climate_group),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Tropical" = "#1b9e77",
      "Arid" = "#d95f02",
      "Temperate" = "#7570b3",
      "Continental" = "#e7298a",
      "Polar" = "#66a61e",
      "No data" = "gray70"
    )
  ) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Geographic Distribution of Amanita Samples by Climate Group",
    x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude",
    color = "Climate Group"
  )


```
